name: Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia 2026 – Manila Leg 3
short_description: A multi-distance race (5km to 32km) organized by Runrio, set for September 6, 2026 at SM Mall of Asia, Pasay, Philippines.
ai_summary: Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia 2026 – Manila Leg 3 is scheduled for September 6, 2026, at SM Mall of Asia in Pasay, Philippines. Organized by Runrio under the Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia brand, the event offers multiple distance options including 32km, 21.1km (half-marathon), 10km, and 5km categories. Registration details have not yet been announced.

faqs.question: When is the Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia 2026 – Manila Leg 3?
faqs.answer: This race is scheduled to take place on September 6, 2026. It is the third leg of the Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia series, organized by Runrio, and will be held in Pasay, Philippines at the SM Mall of Asia venue.

faqs.question: What distances are offered in this race?
faqs.answer: The event offers four distance categories: 5km, 10km, 21.1km (the primary half-marathon distance), and 32km. This range allows participants of varying experience levels and fitness goals to choose a category that suits them, from shorter fun runs to longer endurance challenges.

faqs.question: Is registration open for this race?
faqs.answer: As of now, the registration status for this race has not yet been announced by the organizer, Runrio. Prospective participants should check back for updates regarding sign-up details, fees, and availability closer to the September 2026 event date.

faqs.question: Where is the race held?
faqs.answer: The race takes place at SM Mall of Asia, located in Pasay, Philippines. This venue serves as the starting point for the event, which is part of the Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia series organized by Runrio for its Manila leg.
